mapper.select: select r.code from user_role ur join role r on ur.roleId = r.roleId where ur.userId = #{userId} and r.status = 1
select distinct rp.permissionCode from user_role ur join role r on ur.roleId = r.roleId join role_permission rp on ur.roleId = rp.roleId where ur.userId = #{userId} and r.status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_role (userId, roleId, createTime) value (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{createTime})

sql.if: and (code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select roleId, code, name, description, status, buildIn, createTime, updateTime from role
order by roleId limit #{start}, #{size}
select roleId, code, name from role where status = 1 order by roleId
mapper.insert: insert into role (code, name, description, status, buildIn, createTime, updateTime) value (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{buildIn}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
insert into role_permission (roleId, permissionCode, createTime) value (#{roleId}, #{permissionCode}, #{createTime})
